name: SINGLE TANK ULTRASONIC CLEANER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Single Tank Ultrasonic Cleaner is an industrial-grade washing system crafted with CNC and laser-cut stainless steel 304. Designed for rugged applications, it features adjustable ultrasonic power, a 0-99 hours timer, and advanced temperature controls.
features: Industrial grade construction with thick gauge SS 304 sheets
Digital temperature controller (35°C to 95°C) and digital timer (0 to 99 hours)
CNC and laser cut fabrication for excellent metal finishing
Includes a stainless steel wire mesh basket
